_comment: Edited by people; kernels/gen_kernel_impls.py reads it with vLLM's own MoE oracle and refuses a classification that disagrees with it. The moe.grouped_gemm rows of kernel_impls.json: the kernels vLLM v0.33.0 runs block-FP8 routed experts with, by Fp8MoeBackend member. 'seen' lists the builds AISimulate measured these kernels on, each hashed from its own source, so a coefficient fitted on them can be keyed to the build it ran (D5).

vllm-csrc.seen_in: AISimulate's vLLM 0.30.0 MoE sweep on h100 and h200 (ai-dynamo/aisim 6fdf6fb6b2e1c15b8f5cd1ba35fd2d50cdb2eb18, systems/data/{h100_sxm,h200_sxm}/moe/vllm/0.30.0/collection_meta.yaml): image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0@sha256:8a69ffad015f138d7170c4ddc429e230a3bc1c1719f67e14324749df200a4b90

flashinfer.seen_in: AISimulate's vLLM 0.30.0 MoE sweep on h100 and h200 (ai-dynamo/aisim 6fdf6fb6b2e1c15b8f5cd1ba35fd2d50cdb2eb18, systems/data/{h100_sxm,h200_sxm}/moe/vllm/0.30.0/collection_meta.yaml): image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0@sha256:8a69ffad015f138d7170c4ddc429e230a3bc1c1719f67e14324749df200a4b90, whose vLLM pins flashinfer-python==0.6.18.post1 (requirements/cuda.txt:17@ced6857a)

not_kernels.silu_and_mul_per_block_quant: the activation between the two grouped GEMMs, an elementwise pass
not_kernels.moe_sum: the top-k reduction after the second grouped GEMM
not_kernels.invoke_fused_moe_wna16_triton_kernel: the weight-only int path, not block FP8
not_kernels.try_get_optimal_moe_config: picks the kernel's tile configuration from the configs/ tables, which the hash covers

NONE.reason: no MoE backend: the layer has no routed experts

AITER.reason: AMD's AITer kernels run on ROCm only

AITER_MXFP8.reason: AMD's AITer MXFP8 kernels on gfx950 only

TRITON_MXFP8.reason: a dot_scaled kernel that lowers to CDNA4 MX matrix cores

kernels.note: vLLM's Triton fused grouped GEMM (fused_moe_kernel) with its launcher and the tile configurations it reads
FlashInfer's CUTLASS fused MoE, JIT-built for SM90 from these sources and the CUTLASS it pins
